name: crisp
note: Energetic dev-tool and product films: tight UI ticks and clicks, fast air for moves, one clean gated hit, a short tuned sub drop. Designed members where the idiom is designed (the crisp tick, the gated hit, the sub drop, the bell and confirm dings); clicks, ticks, keys, the snap and the light touches are CC0 recordings fitted as code, where they measure closer to their role than the forge member. Every take passes the model-free audit. Riser, swell and suck are off.

tick.note: domino pieces knocking, a CC0 recording fitted as code (0.14 s): matches 'a soft quiet UI tick' at z +1.02, p 0.67 over synth-blip descriptions (tap/glass: -0.08, p 0.01), realness 0.83 (0.45)

tick.crisp.note: a bright designed tink (37 ms, single attack): the precise UI tick; keep it quiet

tock.note: a knuckle knock: the low partner of the tick

hit.note: one clean gated hit: a single attack, no build (pre-swell 10 ms), 0.67 s; nothing layered on it

land.note: a round low thump for heavier elements landing

land.light.note: light finger steps on a book, a CC0 recording fitted as code (0.38 s): matches 'a soft finger tap on wood' at z +2.07, p 0.99 over synth-blip descriptions (pro_tap/knock: +0.13, p 0.00), realness 0.95 (0.28)

pop.note: a round pop-in thump, no pitch glide: runs of pop-ins stay out of the 8-bit read

whoosh.short.note: a tight fast pass (0.54 s, peak at 0.16 s): whip pans and fly-ins

whoosh.long.note: a full air swell for scene transitions (no jet tone, no tail re-rise)

drop.note: the shortest designed sub drop (1.0 s, blooms 110 ms after the cut); set edits.pitch to the film's root (G1-C2)

key.note: one mechanical key, press and release, a CC0 recording fitted as code (0.43 s, 2.2 kHz centroid: brighter than typing_key/crisp at 0.6 kHz), a new take per keystroke: matches 'a single mechanical keyboard key press' at z +4.65 (typing_key/crisp: +4.48), realness 0.99 (0.95)

key.space.note: a mechanical keyboard space bar, a CC0 recording fitted as code (0.39 s): matches 'a spacebar press' at z +3.22 (typing_key/thock: +2.59), realness 0.99 (0.96)

key.return.note: a clicky switch for return: brighter and firmer than the run

click.note: a small plastic click, a CC0 recording fitted as code (0.13 s, 4.9 kHz centroid): matches 'a soft UI button click' at z +1.70, p 0.73 over synth-blip descriptions (pro_click/mouse: +1.03, 0.35), realness 0.97 (0.06)

click.confirm.note: a short clean ding (0.36 s) for a confirmed action

snap.note: a switch flip, a CC0 recording fitted as code (0.19 s, one attack): matches 'a toggle switch click' at z +2.24, p 1.00 over synth-blip descriptions (toggle/latch, two attacks: +2.04, 0.97), realness 0.97 (0.50)

bell.note: the tuned kalimba voice on two octaves of the key's pentatonic (C: G4-E6, 10 notes, until a retune moves it): progress steps and motifs, a rung for every step

text.note: a finger tapping a phone, a CC0 recording fitted as code (0.33 s, a low soft tap, untuned so it never fights the music: a new take per fragment): its top tag is 'a soft UI button tap'; realness 0.89 (pro_tap/soft, which it replaces, is a designed thump); level +7 dB for its lower loudness at the same peak (95 Hz centroid)

off.suck: off by default: a reverse whoosh into a cut stacks a build onto the reveal
off.riser: off by default; pro_riser/air_gate is the short opt-in, never a shepard riser
off.swell: off by default: a reverse swell before a hit is a stacked lead-in
